verifiedClaims: Two structurally qualifying opposing receipts preserve the VAJRA branch as contested.
A contested receipt set changes the next inspection priority to source_quality and routes that inspection to DROPLET while preserving targetRef and clauseRef.
A single qualifying receipt does not trigger conflict escalation.
A receipt rejected for missing provenance does not trigger conflict escalation and remains audited as rejected.
boundaries: This is structural receipt-driven reprioritization, not semantic adjudication.
The evidence does not prove source truth, source independence, or that DROPLET executed the follow-up.
The capability is an additive VAJRA layer and does not rename or relocate the historical nostromo/ path.
